blind_form_read: Squat cocoa cylinder with a lighter circular crown in the mouth, a C-handle on the right, and a cream-edged foot on the desk plane.
blind_held_read: A compact desk espresso object with a matte cocoa shell, a beige round top disc, and a thick brown handle sticking out to the right.
blind_relationship_read: The disc lives in the cup mouth and moves down relative to the rim; the handle is fixed on the cup wall; the foot sits on the desk.
blind_subjects_read: Cocoa cup body; beige top disc in the mouth; right-side handle; two-panel sheet of the same object.
